title: Consent to Treatment
about: General consent for examination and treatment at the clinic.

blocks.text: I consent to examination, testing and treatment by the providers and staff of {facility.name}, as they judge necessary for my care. This includes routine procedures, laboratory tests, immunizations and medications.
I understand that I may ask questions about any treatment, that I may refuse any treatment, and that I will be asked for separate written consent before any procedure that requires it.
This consent stays in effect until I withdraw it in writing.
